tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// bstod pa rnam dag gi phreng ba bzhugs// ༄༅// rdo rje bdag med ma'i bstod pa rnam dag gi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal lo// ma lus sangs rgyas kun bdag nyid// mkha' 'gro kun dang mnyam sbyor ba// dpal ldan bla mar phyag 'tshal nas// mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor bstod par bgyi// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das dngos kun// gang zhig las ni byung gyur pa// de nyid shes rab pha rol phyin// bdag med ma dpal phyag 'tshal lo// bud med sgyu mas 'khor ba yi// sgyu ma'i spros pa zhes bya'i phyir// ye shes sgyu mar rnam 'phrul ba// sgyu ma chen mor phyag 'tshal lo// gdab pa'i phyir dang 'debs pa'i phyir// mtshon phyir mi 'da' ba yi phyir// rdzogs sangs rgyas nyid phyag rgya cher// yang dag ston la phyag 'tshal lo// chags can rjes su gzhug phyir dang*// chags pas byang chub bsgrub phyir dang*// dngos grub myur phyir lha mo yi// skur gyur rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam shes zhe sdang rnam dag cing*// chos dbyings ye shes bdag nyid thugs// mi bskyod rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid// bdag med ma la phyag 'tshal lo// gzugs dang gti mug rnam dag cing*// me long ye shes ngo bo nyid// rnam par snang mdzad bdag nyid dpal// rdo rje ma la phyag 'tshal lo// tshor ba ser sna rnam dag cing*// mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid// rin chen 'byung gnas bdag nyid dpal// gsang ba'i dkar mor phyag 'tshal lo// 'du shes 'dod chags rnam dag cing*// kun rtog ye shes ngo bo nyid// 'od dpag med pa'i bdag nyid dpal// chu yi rnal 'byor mar phyag 'tshal// 'du byed phrag dog rnam dag cing*// bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid// don yod grub pa'i bdag nyid dpal// rdo rje mkha' 'gro mar phyag 'tshal// sa yi khams ni rnam dag cing*// byams pa chen po'i ngo bo nyid// lha mo spyan ma'i bdag nyid dpal// pukka sī la phyag 'tshal lo// chu yi khams ni rnam dag cing*// snying rje chen po'i ngo bo nyid// mā ma kī yi bdag nyid dpal// ri khrod ma la phyag 'tshal lo// me yi khams ni rnam dag cing*// dga' ba chen po'i ngo bo nyid// gos dkar mo yi bdag nyid dpal// gdol pa mo la phyag 'tshal lo// rlung gi khams ni rnam dag cing*// btang snyoms chen po'i ngo bo nyid// lha mo sgrol ma'i bdag nyid dpal// ḍoṃ bi nī la phyag 'tshal lo// gzugs kyi skye mched rnam dag cing*// dgug dang zhi ba'i las mdzad ma// rdo rje gzugs ma'i bdag nyid dpal// gau rī la ni phyag 'tshal lo// sgra yi skye mched rnam dag cing*// gzhug dang rgyas pa'i las mdzad pa// rdo rje sgra ma'i bdag nyid dpal// tsau rī la ni phyag 'tshal lo// dri yi skye mched rnam dag cing*// bcing dang dbang gi las mdzad pa// rdo rje dri ma'i bdag nyid dpal// be tā lī la phyag 'tshal lo// ro yi skye mched rnam dag c-ing*// dbang dang drag po'i las mdzad pa// rdo rje ro ma'i bdag nyid dpal// ghasma rī la phyag 'tshal lo// reg dang lus ni rnam dag cing*// sa 'og sbyong mdzad sku yi dngos// rdo rje reg ma'i bdag nyid dpal// sa spyod ma la phyag 'tshal lo// chos dang yid ni rnam dag cing*// sa bla skyong mdzad gsung gi dngos// rdo rje dbyings ma'i bdag nyid dpal// mkha' spyod ma la phyag 'tshal lo// lha mo thams cad kha dog gnag

/drag chen phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan// zhal gcig spyan gsum dmar ba la// rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor lo rna cha nor bu dang*// lag gdub dang ni ska rags nyid// sangs rgyas lnga ni rnam dag pa'i// phyag rgya 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo// lag pa gcig ni thod pas brel// g.yas pa na ni gri gug dang*// g.yon na kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa'i// lha mo rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// stag gi pags pas snam dkris shing*// ro la zhon zhing gzi brjid 'bar// dbu skra ser po gyen 'khyil ba'i// lha mo rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// nga rgyal la sogs skyon drug rnams// gcod phyir gri gug rnam par gnas// dngos dang dngos med rnam rtog gi /mgo bo padma'i snod du ni// bdud rnams rnam pa bzhi yi khrag /dngos grub phyir ni rtag gsol zhing*// stong pa'i rnam pas kha ṭwāṃ ga /thabs kyis ro yi gdan la gnas// mi gnas mya ngan 'das dngos phyir// skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs// bco lngas yongs su bskor ba yi// lha mo rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// snod kyi 'jig rten yongs spyod zhing*// yang dag lam ni nyer mtshon byed// rten gnas gyur pa'i bdag nyid dpal// gzhal yas khang la phyag 'tshal lo// lus dang sred pa yongs sbyong zhing*// lha dang 'byung po dbang sdud phyir// gzhal yas khang pa yongs bskor ba'i// dur khrod brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// mi mthun phyogs las rnam rgyal zhing*// bdag gzhan nye bar srung byed pa// mthu stobs mtha' yas bdag nyid dpal// srung ba'i 'khor lor phyag 'tshal lo// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor la// bstod dbyangs rgya mtshos legs mchod pa'i// dge ba gang des 'gro ba kun// ye shes mkha' 'gro nyid gyur cig /rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor la bstod pa rnam dag gi phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rdo rje 'dzin pa 'phags pas chu mo phag gi lo/

gdu bu'i zla ba'i tshes nyi shu gcig gi mtshan mor rgyal po chen po la 'di nyid kyi dbang bskur mdor bsdus pa byas pa'i tshe sbyar ba'o// //tshigs su bcad pa sum cu rtsa gcig yod do// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
